kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنبهر (form VII)
# أَنْبَهِرُ (ʔanbahiru) /ʔan.ba.hi.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْبَهَرَ (inbahara)
# أَنْبَهِرَ (ʔanbahira) /ʔan.ba.hi.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْبَهَرَ (inbahara)
# أَنْبَهِرْ (ʔanbahir) /ʔan.ba.hir/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْبَهَرَ (inbahara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
